implementation: BeholdCastSpec declares a subtype, optional generic decline cost and optional flash permission. An explicit intent precedes payment; the shared ordered transaction holds a non-consuming Behold clause. Funding uses the same borrowed cost context as mana, life, additional costs, Bargain, Convoke, Improvise, Delve and Harmonize.

The exact own-hand or controlled battlefield witness is checked through one shared typed predicate. Hand witnesses become public known-hand facts only when paid, persist while the original spell is on the stack, and invalidate with that hand incarnation. Other hand cards remain hidden. Captured CastInfo.beheld is copied and does not recheck a departed or changed witness.

A flash-only route cannot decline required Behold; another ordinary timing permission can still authorize the spell. The proposed source is projected onto the stack before funding, so it cannot serve as its own hand witness or a costed mana child resource.

MayBehold generalizes the existing owned hand interaction with an optional typed quality and unpaid skip continuation. A private choice exists even with no witness so opponent observation/progression does not reveal hidden hand quality; accepted and declined branches remain source independent.

FreeSpellCast(CastFilter) is an alternative mana cost and grants no origin or timing. The existing turn-free visitor now also checks a live matching provider against the selected spell face. Actual Free casts retain taxes, mandatory additional costs and X0, and cannot borrow Harmonize/flashback-only permission or replace a required resolution alternative.

Independent origin obligations survive the alternative choice: counter-cost and per-source permanent-type graveyard permissions keep their existing receipts; self-graveyard life/selection costs capture the immutable physical cost definition in private Announcement.origin_additional_cost. Separately granted ordinary permission omits those self-route costs. A paid resolving offer has a distinct Free action and preserves its exact origin, quota and continuation.
Ordinary complete spell proposals reuse the existing Harmonize proposal funder with no Harmonize contribution. There is no second payment engine, English runtime parsing or TDM definition change.

artifact_availability_correction.reason: The original report incorrectly grouped a mutable Cargo cdylib with preserved shared libraries and did not distinguish retained native executables from overwritten warm-cache outputs. This correction changes only evidence classification and availability; all historical source, report, log and artifact hashes are retained.
artifact_availability_correction.execution_mode: All nine historical reports compile Rust integration tests with Cargo --no-run and then execute the reported native ELF directly. The unchanged Python runner uses subprocess execution and contains no ctypes, cffi or cdylib loading. These Rust tests consume the rlib; Cargo also emits a cdylib because Cargo.toml requests both crate types.
artifact_availability_correction.elf_evidence_scope: Five run records still match their historical executable hashes: one cast-permission binary and four uses of the same legacy binary. Their historical ELF dependencies were inspected directly. The other four historical executables were overwritten and cannot be retrospectively byte-inspected; their current replacements also require only libgcc_s, libc and the ELF loader. The runner commands, Rust integration-test link configuration and matching historical binaries establish the native execution mode without claiming the four missing executables were preserved.
artifact_availability_correction.availability: Source pins, native/resource reports and execution logs remain available. The old cdylib and four overwritten native executables are not available here at their original hashes. Reproducing those exact source inputs requires rebuilding the immutable checkpoint; no rebuild, cache mutation or FFI validation was performed for this correction.
